name: shut-up-and-code
description: Precise, low-noise code from Codex: one-line comments, why not what, no narration, no unrequested abstractions, reuse before you write.

interface.longDescription: Comments become one line and explain why, not what. No step narration, no changelog comments, no section dividers, no commented-out code. Beyond comments: simplest correct solution at the size of the request, no abstraction before three call sites, search before adding a constant, no swallowed errors, and verify external facts instead of guessing. Ships a dependency-free checker you can wire as a hook.
defaultPrompt: Clean the slop out of this diff.
Review these comments — cut anything that restates the code.
